AshgateHut.why: the old road post's stone hut where Dralin Uveran the gang-master sleeps and keeps his strongbox (record look and hook)

draft.guards_why: the record holds no watch: a Dunmer gang-master and his Owing reed-cutters (held by), so the camp keeps no guard; its people are the gang-master, the cook and the cutters

merchant.why: Okeeh the cook (main quest 1: she asks the new gang's names in the hold, a few steps from where the player wakes): her work spot is the hold's mess table, by its food barrels

plan.source: Military Camp Hjaalmarch (Skyrim, Imperial side) for the camp, laid wholesale at one turn (340, +14100) with its level camp floor carried within 900 units and capped at 150, so its tents stand level on our river bank; Black Marsh & Valenwood's Imperial ship and its furnished hold for the work barge the main quest opens in (owner, 2026-11-21: the lane's recommendation applied). The camp is the closest match for a work camp of tents round a cook's fire; its Imperial tents give Ashgate a look no other place has (Reed-Sill Weir and Karsh-Naal Camp take Ree-An-Wo's hide tents). The stone hut and its room come whole from Journey to Baan Malur's Baan Malur, the one stone cottage with a one-room interior in the marsh's mods.

look.line: a low stone hut on the river bank
look.by: Journey to Baan Malur's stone house (SOMRStonehouse01) with its door frame and a Raven Rock door, south of the cook's fire, set into the slope; its room copied from Baan Malur's own house (BaanDrHutSmall02, cut to the stone house), named Gang-Master's Hut

the source's six Imperial hide tents as it pitches them: three small tents of two bedrolls' room, the long tent (once the field hospital) with four bedrolls, the cook's tent with its bed and dresser, and the mess tent with its trestle tables and pelts

look.line: bundled reed stacked by the landing

look.line: a work barge moored in the pool below the camp
